clause: Auto-layout spacing: wrap, gap (numeric/auto/negative), canvas-stacking, padding [STU-DS-037,STU-DS-038,STU-DS-039,STU-DS-040]

scope.summary: Implement auto-layout spacing on StudioAutoLayout: horizontal wrap (overflowing children flow to the next line for responsive multi-row layouts); gap accepting a numeric value, an auto value (space-between distribution), and negative values (overlapping stacks) while preserving flow order; a canvas-stacking setting controlling first-on-top vs last-on-top render for overlapping children; and padding settable uniformly, per axis, or per individual side. Solving is in the LayoutEngine.
expected_tests: test: wrap flows to next line; gap numeric/auto/negative preserving order; canvas-stacking first/last-on-top; padding uniform/per-axis/per-side
acceptance_criteria_original: auto-layout wrap + numeric/auto/negative gap + canvas-stacking + uniform/per-axis/per-side padding

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-DS-037] Horizontal flow MUST support wrap, flowing overflowing children onto the next line to produce responsive multi-row layouts from a single container.

[STU-DS-038] Gap between children MUST accept a numeric value, an "auto" value (space-between distribution across the container), and negative values (overlapping stacks such as avatar rows) while preserving flow order.
[STU-DS-039] Auto-layout frames MUST expose a canvas-stacking setting controlling whether overlapping children render first-on-top or last-on-top.
[STU-DS-040] Padding MUST be settable uniformly, per axis (horizontal/vertical), or per individual side (top/right/bottom/left).

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.
